As a DevOp who doesn't maintain physical networking infrastructure (another team does that), I'm totally happy letting someone else take on the SDN role. Sure, there are places where the two meet - provisioning automation needs to be able to talk to the SDN systems to get VMs set up in the right "place" on the network, for example - but ultimately the two are pretty different skillsets, and only in small companies would I see there being a real challenge with this.

Keep in mind that some amount of physical networking infrastructure will always be needed, and that a lot of IP, routing, and other skillsets are involved with SDN - it's not always in the wheelhouse of a devop who knows basic IPv4 but couldn't set up OSPF or an IPSEC infrastructure to save their life.
